svg.title: Does a day owe anything? Gothenburg, 2013
svg.desc: The three checks a local day of passages goes through before any fee is computed: a day no tax period covers is refused with 422, an exempt vehicle (bus, diplomat, emergency, foreign, military, or motorcycle) owes nothing on any day, a toll-free day (a Saturday or Sunday, any day of July, a public holiday, or the day before one) owes nothing whatever the passages, and every other day is a charged day.
